Decomposing the 4.1 µs fresh construct+dispatch baseline (245.6k ops/s): construction alone is 2.3 µs (432.2k ops/s) — over half the total — and dispatching a preconstructed, reused event collapses the operation to 1.3 µs (775.9k ops/s), a

This is the largest single lever found anywhere in the synthetic layer, and it comes with a hard boundary: only synthetic
